column1: # Name: Logan River near Franklin Basin
# Description: Logan River Observatory monitoring site for Logan River near Franklin Basin
# Name: Location for Logan River near Franklin Basin

# Description: A datastream of Discharge at Logan River near Franklin Basin with processing level 1.5 and sampled medium Surface water created using a method with name Discharge calculated from water level having units of cubic meters per second
# Name: Discharge calculated from water level
# Description: Discharge determined using quality controlled water level data in conjunction with a site specific stage-discharge relationship.
# MethodType: Instrument deployment or data derived from instrument deployment
# Explanation: Quality controlled data that is subject to change upon further review.
# Output date/time values are in UTC unless they were input to HydroServer without time zone offset information. In that case, date/time values are output as they were supplied to HydroServer.

# WARNING: These data may be provisional and subject to revision. The data are released on the condition that Utah State University may not be held liable for any damages resulting from their use. LRO Data are collected using Mountain Standard Time. Timestamps of data are not shifted for daylight saving time. All raw data and final quality-controlled data are provided; additional processing levels are available upon request. Please contact loganriverobservatory@usu.edu for more information.
